title: trench crusade intro
description: give a brief introduction to the lore and setting of trench crusade

script.draft:
[VISUAL: dark, rain-soaked battlefield at night — barbed wire, artillery craters, gothic church ruins in the background, soldiers in medieval-style armor carrying rifles, hellish red light on the horizon]

The Crusades never ended. They just got worse.

Trench Crusade is a tabletop miniatures game set in an alternate history where the Crusaders failed — and in failing, cracked open a door to Hell. Literally. Demons walked out. The world never recovered.

Now it's 1914. Trenches stretch across a continent scarred by centuries of holy war. Men fight with rifles, bayonets, and relics. Angels clash with horrors from the pit. The Catholic Church fields warrior-saints. Hell deploys its own armies.

It's World War One — but the enemy isn't just the other side of no man's land. It's damnation itself.

Trench Crusade takes the horror of modern warfare and layers centuries of religious mythology on top. The result is something unlike anything else in tabletop gaming.

script.description: What if the Crusades failed — and Hell literally won? Trench Crusade is an indie tabletop miniatures game set in a world where demonic forces walk the earth and World War One is fought with bayonets, relics, and divine fire. This video breaks down the core lore and setting so you know exactly what kind of world you're stepping into. Drop a comment if you want a deeper dive into any of the factions.
